message.content:
I don’t track that kind of thing—it’s not my job. The platform shows me what’s happening with *my* company’s drones, but not the others’. If you want to know how many flights were affected across all companies, you’d have to ask the platform team or look at their logs.

All I know is that yesterday’s closure near the industrial zone messed up a few of *my* deliveries. We had to reroute some drones and cancel a couple of inspections because the drones couldn’t get back in time. But I don’t know what happened with the other companies.
